name: FNF Foundation Repair

hero.title: We fix what
hero.lead: FNF Foundation Repair is a locally owned company in Pasadena, working on Houston-area homes with slab repair, pier and beam repair, house leveling and under-slab tunneling.

highlights.title: Locally owned, no subcontractors
highlights.text: The same crew handles the job from inspection to completion.

highlights.title: 2-hour callback, 7 days
highlights.text: We call back within 2 business hours, 7 days a week.

steps.title: Free inspection
steps.text: Our certified inspector evaluates your foundation and delivers a full written report, at no cost and no obligation.

steps.title: Custom plan
steps.text: We present a written estimate with clear options and flexible scheduling around your timeline and budget.

steps.title: Repair and warranty
steps.text: Our crew completes the work, and every job is backed by a lifetime transferable warranty with written documentation of all repairs.

reviews.author: Carolina Rodriguez
reviews.text: We had a great experience with FNF Foundation. Erik and his crew were highly professional, arriving early and finishing our foundation lift in a single day. Erik took the time to answer all our questions, and the pricing was very fair. Highly recommended!

reviews.author: Bridget D
reviews.text: After a couple inspections for estimates I hired FNF to repair some foundation issues I had. I couldn't be more pleased...Erik had done a thorough inspection & explained how everything would be done & at a fair price.. there was good communication prior to the repair day ...On the repair day Erik took before & after pictures to show me which was much appreciated ...Overall these guys do excellent work & Erik is a genuinely good & honest person..l highly recommend them...Thank You!

summary: Under-slab tunneling, pier and beam repair and house leveling for homes in Pasadena, Pearland and Katy.

groups.title: Pier & Beam Foundation Repair
groups.summary: We restore shifting support beams, replace rotted wood, and eliminate moisture damage.
groups.intro: We restore shifting support beams, replace rotted wood, and eliminate moisture damage.

groups.title: Under-Slab Tunneling
groups.summary: FNF Foundation Repair's signature service — we access plumbing and foundation systems beneath your slab by tunneling from outside.
groups.intro: FNF Foundation Repair's signature service — we access plumbing and foundation systems beneath your slab by tunneling from outside. No breaking your floors. No interior mess.

groups.title: House Leveling Services
groups.summary: We restore your home to a safe, level position using professional-grade hydraulic equipment.
groups.intro: We restore your home to a safe, level position using professional-grade hydraulic equipment.

groups.title: Concrete Slab Repair
groups.summary: We lift settled slabs, seal cracks, and stabilize your foundation against further movement.
groups.intro: We lift settled slabs, seal cracks, and stabilize your foundation against further movement.

groups.title: Custom Leveling Plan
groups.summary: Based on the assessment, we develop a targeted plan: pier installation, mudjacking, polyurethane foam injection, or a combination.
groups.intro: Based on the assessment, we develop a targeted plan: pier installation, mudjacking, polyurethane foam injection, or a combination. A written estimate with no surprises.

about.title: Not a franchise. Built to protect Houston homes from the foundation up.
text: FNF Foundation Repair is a locally owned company serving Greater Houston, built around one mission: protecting Houston homes from the foundation up.
We are based in Pasadena, and we live and work here, with no call centers and no subcontractors sent from out of state.
Our own crew handles every job start to finish, so you see the same faces from inspection to completion.
